BiblicalUsage: Hethlon is a place on the northern border of the land, named twice in Ezekiel's vision of the restored borders. The boundary runs by the way of Hethlon to the entering of Hamath, a fixed point on the edge of the land God promises to His people.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the borders in Ezekiel are God's promise drawn on a map, and Hethlon marks how exact His promises are.
